personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A serene, premium wellness space that combines iOS-native structural clarity with cinematic, glass-layered depth, creating a calm and highly focused $100M app experience.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cards use 'lg' padding. Single column cards span 100% width minus outer padding. Ensure safe-area clearances at roots.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Use frosted glass overlay on hero meal photo cards (Apple Fitness style)
Ensure translucent tinted base (≥70% opacity in light, ≥75% in dark) under text on glass for readability
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list rows or form fields
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces per screen
Do not make the entire screen blurred

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A chat-like conversational multi-step flow capturing user health data with a premium feel.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with 'Preparing your personalized plan...' text.
states.error: Failed to sync profile data. 'Retry' button in primary brand styling.

screens.layout: Bottom-anchored chat input area (glassmorphism), with chat bubbles (OnboardingChatBubble) fading and sliding up from the bottom. Top area reserved for AI persona greeting. Smooth 60fps transitions between steps.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Health Dashboard showing AI Body Analysis, macro rings (Apple Fitness style), charts, and streaks.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for macro rings and charts.
states.empty: Illustration of a healthy lifestyle with CTA 'Start tracking today'.
states.error: Unable to load dashboard data. 'Retry' CTA.

screens.layout: Large hero section with Apple-style Animated Macro Rings (MacroRing). Below, scrollable cards for HabitTracker (water/steps/sleep). Use 'lg' spacing and 'lg' border radii. Floating cards for StatsCard with subtle shadows and clean typography.

screens.name: Meal Plan
screens.purpose: 7/14/30 days AI Meal Planner with beautiful photography, Smart Meal Replacement, and Shopping List.

states.loading: Skeleton layout mimicking WeekPlanCarousel and MealCard.
states.empty: Icon of a plate with text 'No meal plan generated yet.' and 'Create Plan' CTA.
states.error: Could not fetch meal plan. 'Retry' CTA.

screens.layout: Top section: WeekPlanCarousel (horizontal scroll). Main section: Vertical list of MealCards. Each MealCard has a full-width hero photo with a gradient-to-dark scrim, placing macros and titles at the bottom. Include a floating 'Shopping List' glass button.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: Camera-first Photo Food Scanner and manual add flow.

states.loading: Translucent overlay with AI scanning animation (60fps scale/opacity).
states.error: Failed to analyze food. 'Retake Photo' CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view (PhotoScannerFrame). Bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) slides up with scan results, macros, and 'Add to Diary' primary CTA sticky at the bottom. Use transform/opacity animations for performance.

screens.name: AI Chat
screens.purpose: Conversational AI Nutritionist chat and Blood Test PDF Upload.

states.empty: Suggested prompt chips (e.g., 'Analyze my blood test', 'What should I eat post-workout?').

screens.layout: Chat interface with ChatBubbles. Include a BloodTestUploadCard at the top of the empty state or triggered via an attachment icon. Input field pinned to bottom with safe-area spacing.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage Family Mode, Subscriptions (Free/Pro/Family), and app settings.
screens.layout: Header with avatar and name. Vertical list of settings rows. A prominent SubscriptionPlanCard with glassmorphism to highlight 'Pro' or 'Family' upgrade, showcasing features. Family Mode toggle opens a bottom sheet to switch profiles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces' personality. The UI must feel like a $100M startup: premium, minimal, calm.
Follow the exact color tokens provided. Do NOT use default Material indigo or blue. The primary brand color is a sage/emerald green (#4C7D64).
Typography must be restricted to font weights 400 and 500 ONLY. Use size and color contrast for hierarchy, not heavy weights.
Ensure safe area is respected at every screen root. Content never sits under the notch.
Implement Apple Fitness-style animated macro rings on the Dashboard. Make sure to use Reanimated for 60fps performance.
For the Scanner screen, use a camera-first layout with a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for results, ensuring transitions rely on transform and opacity.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims (top to bottom, transparent -> 70%+ surfaceInverse) on all MealCard hero photos so text remains perfectly legible.
Onboarding should be a smooth conversational chat interface, replacing standard web-like forms.
Include a BloodTestUploadCard that looks premium (use glassmorphism and the blood_test_bg image with a heavy tint).
Ensure the SubscriptionPlanCard uses premium spacing, border radii (lg/24px), and glassmorphism to look luxurious.
Handle Dark Mode and Light Mode natively utilizing the provided tokens.
